comments.body: Lol that is the reason so many celebrities move here. Tina Turner as an example gave an interview where she explained one of the main reason she moved here is that she can go about her day alone in peace, shop her own groceries etc. and no one comes up to her and if they do it is mostly an expat or tourist. Charlie Chaplin expressed similar sentiments back in the day. To each his own
comments.author: ElectronicCountry701
